delivery_stages.model_endpoint: First raw answer to selected raw answer; the first answer is after any within-visit tools.
delivery_stages.semantics: Initial raw Solver to selected raw Solver, then selected raw Solver to final delivery; associations, not causal credit. Unparsed entity states stay unknown.

semantics.mapping: Declared store-local value ID suffix; no label inferred from content.
semantics.support: A nonempty own-intent value block is present in the actual initial Perception request.
semantics.support_scope: Own-intent card presence only; cross-intent contrasts in other cards are not counted.

timing.cold_start_limit: First slot-count admissions are a diagnostic group, not a proven cold wave; the remaining samples are not guaranteed warm. No slow-sample trimming.
timing.first_sample_rule: First admitted roster member, regardless of finish order; exclude exactly this member from the separately reported remaining-sample mean.
timing.quality_constraint: Executor completion does not establish answer correctness or reliability. Compare official task quality and delivery reliability alongside latency; cache reuse is diagnostic only.
timing.timing_scope: Monotonic admission-to-settled-workflow wall time includes internal model/tool waits, FIT and cleanup. Pre-admission wait is separate. Roster preparation, final persistence and official scoring are excluded. Batch wall per sample measures throughput, not individual latency.

raw_primary_paired_transitions: Not present in qualified aggregate reports; do not infer from marginal counts or delivered-answer contrasts.

registered_local_rule.plateau_rule: After two complete local updates without any primary improvement over the retained local version, lock the best observed version and move to the next named local problem. Any further update is a new prospective root decision.
registered_local_rule.primary: draft_entity_correct.numerator / input_count; invalid or missing draft counts as incorrect
tie_breaks: unchanged local control on exact tie

resampling.unit: paired utterance; keep all recording variants together
